text:
Maya: Morning—async standup. Quick notes: did onboarding of nova-7b-quantv2 to staging and ran the promptset-es-v2 eval. Observed +2.1% avg perplexity and a spike in hallucination_score. Blocker: spanish date parsing is flaky (returns '32 de enero' for some inputs). Today: triage with Jin, open CR for quant config, ping Oliver for PR review on #492.

Sam: saw the perf shift, can you paste the eval command you ran?

Maya: sure — run I used: ```bash
./eval_runner --model nova-7b-quantv2 --promptset promptset-es-v2 --out /tmp/eval.json
```

Maya: small sample from logs: ```
ERROR parse_date at tokenize(): input='1/2/23' -> model output='32 de enero'
traceback: none, just wrong generation
```

Jin: I'll take triage. Can you dump failing examples and a minimal repro?

Maya: dropping 6 failing examples to the thread in a sec. Most are locale-specific tokens + short-history prompts.

Oliver: I can review PR #492 later today, add me as reviewer and ping when ready :+1:

Sam: quick idea — try toggling KV cache in staging (might be alignment after quant). Example: `REWRITE_KV_CACHE=false ./start_serving.sh` — see if outputs change.

Maya: good call, trying kv=false now.

OncallBot: Canary deploy started for nova-7b-quantv2 at 1769990012 (10% traffic).

Maya: note — when kv=false one failing example fixed, two others still bad. Leaving kv on for now, will include results in triage doc.

Oliver: also noticing tokenizer length distribution shifted after quant/packaging step. Recommend running tokenizer stats: `python tools/tokenizer_stats.py --model-path /models/nova-7b-quantv2` and compare to baseline.

Sam: running tokenizer stats now, will post diff by EOD.

Maya: Oliver — can you add a quick PR comment listing the regression metrics to track? I suggest: [date_parse_accuracy, hallucination_rate, answer_length_mean]. Also include a tiny script to emit them to the console.

Oliver: done, added comment and a tiny summary in the PR. Pushed a link to a draft dashboard: https://go.redwood/intern/dash/nova-qa (placeholder).

Maya: thanks. If kv tweak fixes most things we can try a config rollout, otherwise I will draft rollback/playbook and post to #incidents if it escalates.

Jin: starting detailed triage now — I'll reproduce failures with seeds and check tokenization boundary cases. Ping me if you encounter more examples.

Sam: will add a smoke CI test: `pytest tests/smoke_date_parsing.py -k nova` and queue it on staging.

DeployBot: Canary promotion completed at 1769990048 — nova-7b-quantv2 promoted to 100% routing. No errors > threshold during canary.

Maya: ack, thanks both. Keeping watch and will post triage notes and repro artifacts in this thread.

Jin: update incoming in ~30m with tokenization diffs.

Sam: FYI I found a few token merges that likely caused numeric tokenization quirks (sharing in follow-up).

Maya: perfect — will coordinate PR/rollback depending on findings.

Oliver: tagging for CR follow-up: @Oliver (review done), @Sam (CI smoke), @Jin (triage).

Maya: closing for now — will append concrete next steps once triage finishes.
